verdict.rationale: Redacting sensitive data before it is stored is a fair question for a tracing and observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents masking, redaction, or pre-storage scrubbing hooks in the SDK or platform. Self-hosted data storage and permission groups are adjacent data-control features and do not earn credit for redaction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
